description: This is a TypeScript source file defining an API client for a Vue.js frontend application. It sets up an Axios instance with interceptors for authentication and error handling, and exports multiple API modules (auth, products, cart, orders, users) with methods for interacting with a backend server for an online shopping system.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Sends user credentials to login endpoint, returning an authentication response.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided user data.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by calling the logout endpoint.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Fetches the profile information of the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all products.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a product by its ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product. Admin only.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing product by ID. Admin only.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID. Admin only.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's shopping cart.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart.

methods.name: updateItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order based on the current cart and shipping address.

methods.name: getUserOrders
methods.description: Retrieves the order history of the current user.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches order details by ID.

methods.name: getAllOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all orders (admin only).

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an order (admin only).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all users (admin only).

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID (admin only).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates user data (admin only).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a user (admin only).

ctags.name: AxiosError
ctags.pattern: /^import axios, { type AxiosInstance, type AxiosError } from 'axios'$/

ctags.name: AxiosInstance
ctags.pattern: /^import axios, { type AxiosInstance, type AxiosError } from 'axios'$/
